# Atlas Hydration

> Atlas Hydration makes zero-sugar electrolyte drink mixes in single-serve stick packs. Founded by Garrett Ray, a 787 pilot who travels internationally and plays padel. Made in the USA, third-party tested.

## Products
- [Strawberry Lemonade Electrolytes](https://atlas-hydration.com/products/strawberry-lemonade): 16 stick packs. Per stick: sodium 600 mg, potassium 500 mg, magnesium 200 mg, vitamin C 90 mg, B vitamins, L-Glutamine 1,000 mg, L-Alanine 200 mg. 0 g sugar, 6 g total carbohydrate, 25 calories. Sweetened with stevia and allulose.
- [Grapefruit Electrolytes](https://atlas-hydration.com/products/grapefruit): same formula, grapefruit flavor (pre-order).
- [Atlas Performance Water Bottle](https://atlas-hydration.com/products/bottle): 26 oz, BPA-free, leak-free cap.

## Policies
- [Shipping and returns](https://atlas-hydration.com/shipping): 1-2 business days processing, 4-6 business days delivery, free shipping on orders over $40 and on subscriptions, 30-day satisfaction guarantee.
- [Privacy](https://atlas-hydration.com/privacy) and [Terms](https://atlas-hydration.com/terms)
